title: V3 stage-oriented refactor P11 candidate-layout compatibility bridge
goal: Enable the current trusted base to validate the P11 candidate's split authority and profile layouts without exempting any protected removal, policy weakening or trusted-component change.
acceptanceCriteria: Only a plan whose id and filename both end in -aggregate may name exact paths and area ids newer than the base taxonomy, while Diff still rejects every out-of-plan path.

Base-owned candidate validation accepts exactly one schema-valid legacy or candidate layout for policy, authority, profile, history and projections, and rejects traversal, dual layouts, drift and unregistered policy files.
The fixed P11 candidate passes policy-candidate validation and protected classification contains zero unregistered paths while retaining every substantive authorization obligation.
Every text class hashed by V3 Analyze has LF checkout authority and the committed IFX inventory reproduces byte-for-byte in Linux and Windows fresh checkouts.
